en:
獅子吼"...Yoritsuna Okabe rejected the call to surrender. He led his bannermen out in person, so our forces met them head-on."

獅子吼"Heavy fighting over Lake Inawashiro. Two hours in, nearly every enemy frame was destroyed and air superiority was ours. Almost at the same moment, the rebel ground troops declared surrender."
ja:
獅子吼
「……岡部頼綱は降伏勧告を拒絶。
　自ら旗本衆を率いて討って出たため、我が
方はこれを迎撃――」

獅子吼
「猪苗代湖上空で激しい戦闘となったものの、
二時間後には敵騎をほぼ殲滅、制空権の掌握
に成功しました。
　ほぼ同時に地上の反乱部隊が降伏を宣言」

en:
獅子吼"Chief instigator Yoritsuna Okabe: fell in battle. His heir Jubei Yoriyoshi: set fire to the residence and committed seppuku. Genshin Omura and Kisaburo Takano also fell in battle. Okabe's second son, Rokuyomaru: caught while fleeing, and killed."

獅子吼"Every other man of note has been killed, captured or has surrendered, one of the three. I consider it safe to conclude that the Okabe faction is destroyed."
ja:
獅子吼
「首謀者岡部頼綱は討死、嫡男十兵衛頼良は
館に火を放って切腹。
　大村玄信、高野喜三郎も討死を遂げ、岡部
の次子六曜丸は逃走中を捕殺」

獅子吼
「その他、主だった者どもは全て戦死、捕縛、
投降、いずれかの命運を辿っております。
　岡部一党は壊滅したと断定して宜しいかと」

en:
護氏"...Some towns and villages sided with the rebellion and supplied goods and men. There were several. What became of them?"

獅子吼"As always. Every resident executed, every house burned down to the foundations. Nothing left but wasteland."

護氏"Achha. Well done."

獅子吼"Ji!"

護氏"Yoritsuna... For years that hateful fellow bowed to my face and sneered behind my back, and never troubled to hide it. And yet, now that the proof of his death is here before me, I feel something strange."

護氏"To think I shall never hear that poisonous tongue again... heh. Oddly, I feel lonely. Thinking back, his poison was a certain kind of entertainment in its way."

童心"Hah-hah-hah! Maharaj says whatever suits him!"
ja:
護氏
「……反乱に加担し、物資や兵員を提供した
町村がいくつかあったはずだな。
　それは、どうした」



獅子吼
「常の通りに。
　住民は全て処刑、家屋は根こそぎ焼き払い、
何も残らぬ荒地と致しました」



護氏
「宜しい。
　大儀であった」



獅子吼
「はッ！」



護氏
「頼綱め……
　長年、予に対して公然と面従腹背の姿勢を
見せてきおった憎い奴だが、こうして生首に
なった姿と対面してみると妙な感慨がある」



護氏
「こやつの毒舌をもう聞けぬと思うとな……
ふふ、不思議なほど寂しさを感じてならん。
　思えば奴の毒、あれはあれでなかなか一興
であった」



童心
「はぁっはっは！
　殿も勝手なことを申される！」

en:
童心"Only the other day, every second sentence from you was, ‘Okabe must die! No rest for me until even his remains are disposed of!’ Over and over, Maharaj. My ears grew calluses."

童心"And now the fellow is dead, and this is the speech! Arre baba, what a difficult man my lord is!"

護氏"Doushin, you need not tell me. I am hearing myself also. That thorn is out of my eye; now there is room for thoughts I never had while it was there."

護氏"While a man lives you wish him dead; once he is dead you wish him alive. You need not tell me, holy man. The human heart is willful through and through. It is built never to be satisfied."

童心"Exactly! Satisfaction is missing, so a man struggles for it; in struggling, he improves. Give him complete satisfaction and what remains? Wood, stone. Enlightened, certainly. Useful to the world? Nothing doing."

童心"My lord becomes a living Buddha, and who is to look after the country? No, no, selfishness is very necessary! Kindly continue doing precisely as you please, my lord!"

獅子吼"...What kind of sermon is this?"

護氏"Doushin is too much for me. Heh, heh, heh..."

Raichou"Well, in any case—"
ja:
童心
「先日までは事あるたび、岡部の首を持って
参れ、奴の首を犬に食わせてやるまでは眠る
こともできぬと、返す返す仰られていたに。
　それがし、耳にたこができましたぞ」



童心
「それがいざ死んでみれば、この仰りよう。
　いやはや、困った御方じゃ！」



護氏
「そう言ってくれるな、童心坊。
　予とてわかっておる……目の上の瘤が取れ、
心持ちに余裕ができたればこそそんな思いも
浮かぶのだ。かつては考えもせなんだことを」

護氏
「生きておれば死を望み、死に果てれば生を
望む……全く、御坊ごぼうに言われるまでもない。
　人の心の働きというのは本当に勝手なもの
よ。どこまでも満足せぬように出来ておる」



童心
「であればこそ、人は満足を求めてあがき、
自らを高めるのでござる。
　満ち足りた人間は木石も同然、悟りの境地
ではござるが、世の役には立ち申さぬ」

童心
「殿がかような生き仏になっては御国の大事。
　いや、勝手な言い草おおいに結構！　殿に
おかれてはどうか今後とも、自侭になさって
くださりませい！」



獅子吼
「……どういう説法だ」



護氏
「かなわんな、童心坊には。
　ふっふっふ……」



雷蝶
「まぁ、何に致しましても」

en:
Raichou"Whatever else may be said, the anti-shogunate forces in and around Kanto are now almost entirely swept away. My congratulations, Father. First of all."

護氏"Hm. You also worked hard."

Raichou"Such gracious words! And I could contribute so little to putting down this rebellion..."

獅子吼"Truly. Not one shipment from the line under your charge ever reached the front. Not one."

Raichou"Th-that could not be helped! The anti-shogunate guerrillas blew up the railway! We beat them so badly last time, I thought they were finished..."

獅子吼"Are you an idiot? Their kind spring up endlessly. There is no ‘finished.’"

獅子吼"You neglected even basic vigilance. The blame on you is heavy."

Raichou"Ugh..."

獅子吼"I am not demanding seppuku. But why not shave that garish head, Raichou? I have long found your eye-stabbing ugliness unbearable."

Raichou"You are picking a fight with ME?! My magnificent person is u-u—UGLY?! Aankh hai ya button, madarchod—what bloody eyes are you using?! A vassal's vassal, a jumped-up nobody—and I am to let you walk away?!"

獅子吼"Make me pay, by all means. From you, I do not expect the price to be high."

獅子吼"Any time. If you want a fight, come."

Raichou"Tu—tu—YOU...!"

童心"Now, now, Raichou. Calm down first. Take a seat."

Raichou"Doushin saab, aap hi batao—what chutiyapa is this?! He insults me, and now I must politely accept his invitation to fight?! I am direct blood of the Ashikaga! This is rebellion! Beheading this very minute is the MINIMUM—"

護氏"Be still."

Raichou"F-Father..."

護氏"I do not think you have done nothing. But first merit in this war belongs to Shishiku, who led his own troops and put down the rebellion. Put up with some loose talk from him."

護氏"Otherwise it is your own stature that will be questioned."

Raichou"...Y-yes."

獅子吼"Hmph..."

Raichou"Kh..."

護氏"Shishiku, restrain yourself as well. I know every word comes from loyalty to me, but to an onlooker it can look like arrogance."

護氏"That would do you harm."

獅子吼"Ha. I will keep it in mind."

童心"Hah-hah-hah! Young people should have this much spirit. Lock horns, by all means, by all means. Only my lord, who by his position must always play referee, has a hard time of it."

護氏"..."

Chachamaru"I mean—"
ja:
雷蝶
「これで関東近隣から反幕府勢力はほぼ一掃
されたと言えましょう。
　まずはおめでとうございます、お父様」



護氏
「うむ。
　そちも御苦労であった」



雷蝶
「勿体ないお言葉！
　此度の乱ではあまり大した貢献も出来ませ
なんだのに……」



獅子吼
「本当にな。
　貴様の担当したラインからの補給は、遂に
一度も前線まで届かなかった」



雷蝶
「あっ……あれは仕方ないのよっ！
　討幕派のゲリラに鉄道を爆破されちゃった
んだから！　あいつら、こないだ散々叩いた
からもう大丈夫だと思っていたのに……」



獅子吼
「馬鹿か？
　その手の輩はいくらでも湧いてくる。もう
大丈夫、などということはない」

獅子吼
「当然の警戒を怠った貴様の責任は重大だ」



雷蝶
「うぐ……」



獅子吼
「腹を切れとまでは言わんが、そのけばけば
しい頭を丸めてみるのはどうだ？　雷蝶。
　貴様のその、目に刺さるような見苦しさは
耐え難いと、かねがね思っていたところだ」



雷蝶
「あんた喧嘩売ってんのっ!?　こっ、この麿
の美々しい姿が、みみみ見苦しいですって!?
　許せないわ！　陪臣またもの上がりの癖に！　只で
済むとは思ってないでしょうね!?」



獅子吼
「只で済ませてくれなくとも良い。
　貴様なら別段、高い出費を覚悟する必要も
無さそうだ」

獅子吼
「いつでも構わん。
　一戦交えるのが望みなら、掛かってくるが
いい」



雷蝶
「な、な、なっ……」



童心
「まぁまぁ、雷蝶殿。
　まずは落ち着いて。お座りなされい」



雷蝶
「でも、童心様！
　今のお聞きになったでしょう、足利家直系
の麿に対して暴言の数々！
　これはもう反逆よッ、今すぐ打ち首に――」



護氏
「静まれ」



雷蝶
「お、お父様……」



護氏
「そちに働きがないとは予は考えておらん。
　だが此度の戦、功一等は自ら手兵を率いて
乱を鎮圧した獅子吼。多少の放言は受容せよ」



護氏
「さもなくばそちの器量が問われようぞ」



雷蝶
「……は、はっ」



獅子吼
「ふん……」



雷蝶
「くっ……」



護氏
「獅子吼。そなたも控えよ。
　全て予への忠義から出た言葉であることは
わかっておるが、傍目には驕りとも映る」

護氏
「それではそなたの損になろう」



獅子吼
「はっ。
　心致します」



童心
「はっはっはっ。まぁ、若い者はこれくらい
元気な方が宜しい。角突き合わせるのも結構
結構。立場上いつも仲裁役に回らねばならぬ
殿には、なかなか、御難儀なことでござるが」



護氏
「……」



茶々丸
「つーか」

en:
Chachamaru"Basically he is the poor papa holding together a family with way too much personality, all in the wrong direction. Arre, wait. He literally is. Grandpa, tough life, yaar."

Raichou"You are the last person to say it! Who gives Father the most trouble? You, obviously, you! Think about it!"

Chachamaru"Eh? What has apun done now?"

獅子吼"You did nothing. Less even than Raichou. Right to the end you showed no sign of sending troops or supplies. What was the idea?"

Chachamaru"Idea? First consider geography, bhai. Apun's headquarters: Izu Peninsula. Your destination: Aizu. In between, the whole middle of Kanto. This is where you want the cargo pushed through?"

Chachamaru"Railway gone; air route, storm; sea route, also storm. Transport by which route, kindly specify. Complaints go to that lantern anglerfish and Typhoon Number Fifteen. Apun is the wrong address."

Raichou"W-w-who is a lantern anglerfish?!"

獅子吼"You."

獅子吼"Even so, finding some way to deliver is the duty of anyone entrusted with an army at Rokuhara. That needs no saying, Chachamaru. In fact, Doushin delivered it by vehicle."

Chachamaru"And apun should do all that also? No, yaar. Too much trouble."

Chachamaru"It got settled nicely without it, no? Result is good, therefore all is good. Apply that logic for this once."

獅子吼"You..."

Chachamaru"Arre, anger down, temperature down. And listen properly, Shishiku: apun did not do nothing either."

獅子吼"Liar. You contributed neither at the front nor in supply. What did you do?"

Chachamaru"Propaganda."

Raichou"...Huh? What is that?"

Chachamaru"Got an editorial printed in the Yamato North-South News. Apun wrote it, they printed it under a staffer’s name. See, if the public hates us too much, that is not good, so a little defense of this affair."

童心"Oho, oho. And what sort of editorial, Chachamaru?"

Chachamaru"Something like this."
ja:
茶々丸
「わりかしヤな方向で個性あり過ぎな一家を
まとめる苦労人パパって感じだよなー。いや、
まんまそうか？
　おじじもほんと、大変だね」



雷蝶
「あんたが言わないでよッ！
　お父様にいつも一番迷惑掛けてるのはどう
考えたってあんたでしょうがッ!?」



茶々丸
「えー。あて、なんかした？」



獅子吼
「……何もしとらんな。雷蝶以上に。
　貴様、とうとう最後まで兵も物資も寄越す
そぶりさえ見せなかったが……一体どういう
つもりだ？」



茶々丸
「どーもこーも。
　あての本陣がどこだか知ってんだろ。伊豆
半島から関東を中央突破して会津まで送れっ
てーの？　無茶言えよな」

茶々丸
「鉄道は駄目、空路も海路も荒れてて駄目っ
てな状況で輸送ができるわけねえし。
　文句なら、そこの提灯鮟鱇ちょうちんあんこうと台風一五号に
言っとけ。あてに言うな、あてに」



雷蝶
「だだっ……誰が提灯鮟鱇よッ!?」



獅子吼
「貴様だ」

獅子吼
「それでもどうにかして送るのが、六波羅に
あって一軍を預かる者の義務であるくらい、
言わずともわかろう。茶々丸。
　実際、童心殿は車両運送で届けてきた」



茶々丸
「あてにもそうしろって？
　やだよかったりぃ」



茶々丸
「いいじゃん、あっさりカタついたんだしさ。
結果オーライってーことで。ここはひとつ」



獅子吼
「貴様……」



茶々丸
「あー怒るな怒るな。暑苦しいから。
　だいたい、獅子吼さ。あてだってなんにも
やんなかったわけじゃないよ」



獅子吼
「嘘をつけ。
　前線でも兵站でも貢献しなかった貴様が何
をしたと云うのだ」



茶々丸
「宣伝工作」



雷蝶
「……は？
　何よ、それ」



茶々丸
「大和南北新聞に社説を掲載してもらったの。
　あてが書いたやつを社員の名前で。いやさ、
あんまり世間の反感買うのもアレだし、今回
の件についてちょっと擁護をね」



童心
「ほう、ほう。
　茶々丸殿、それはどのような？」



茶々丸
「こんなよーな」

en:
『THE FRIENDSHIP MASSACRE』◆

The rebellion of Yoritsuna Okabe at Aizu-Inawashiro has ended with the extermination of his entire clan and every follower. Since this was rebellion against the State, the measure was unavoidable, that is not in doubt. Still, when we think of the suffering of those who met such a terrible end, our sorrow is very difficult to suppress.

Some in society appear to be growing angry and dissatisfied with Rokuhara. But one minute only, please. What will we get by hating the State? Instead we should ask why the shogunate, our governing body which protects us citizens, went so far as to do such a thing. We should think, we should understand, and for the future we should endure what is to be endured and make effort to build a fresh, peaceful relationship, so that they never have to do this to us again.

If we do so, the annihilation of the Okabe faction will be handed down to later generations not as a tragedy but as ‘The Friendship Massacre’, the event that joined government and people, the start of a happy age.

This is the duty of those who remain, and the way to honor the noble sacrifice of the Okabe people. This much I cannot help feeling.
ja:
『友情の虐殺』◆
　
　会津猪苗代で勃発した岡部頼綱の反乱は、一族郎党
皆殺しという結末を迎えた。国家に対する反逆である
以上やむを得ない処置であるとはいえ、凄惨な最期を
遂げた人々の苦しみを思うと、悲嘆の情感は抑え難い
ものがある。

　世間には六波羅に対して怒りと不満を募らせる風潮
もあるようだ。しかし、ちょっと待って欲しい。国家
を憎んだところで何が得られるというのだろう。ここ
はむしろ、我々国民を守る統治組織である幕府がなぜ、
あえてそのような行為をするに至ったかを考え、理解
し、今後は彼らにそうさせないよう、耐えるべきこと
は耐えて、新たに平和な関係を築くため努力するべき
ではないのか。

　そうすれば、岡部党鏖殺のこの事件は、後世に悲劇
としてではなく、官民を結び付けるきっかけとなった
『友情の虐殺』として、幸福な時代の始まりとして、
伝えられてゆくのではないだろうか……。
　それこそが残された人々の義務であり、岡部の人々
の尊い犠牲に報いる道だと、私には思えてならないの
である。

en:
護氏"..."

獅子吼"..."

Chachamaru"Well? Look at the supreme craftsmanship of that change of subject."

獅子吼"Where?!"

Raichou"It reads exactly like a declaration of war!!"

Chachamaru"Arre, nothing like that. Look."

童心"GAH-HAH-HAH-HAH!"

Chachamaru"Got a laugh."

獅子吼"Doushin!"

Raichou"That is not the point! You wrote this just to get a laugh?!"

Chachamaru"The age of politics by force alone is finished. Now entertainment has come, keep up!"

Raichou"I cannot make out what that means!"

Chachamaru"Jellyfish outbreak or what?"

童心"No, no. The investigation report has come in on the incident in my jurisdiction where one whole village was wiped out."

獅子吼"...Ah."

Raichou"If it is not cheerful, then it is as we expected, Doushin saab?"

童心"Looked at another way, there are few happier stories. No survivors. Cleanly, completely killed. Old, young, man, woman, all alike turned into silent corpses."

童心"The report says the sheer abnormal peculiarity of the incident almost certainly points to the appearance of Silver Star."

獅子吼"...Silver Star!"

護氏"Eyewitnesses?"

童心"Again, as usual..."

護氏"None, then."

童心"None reliable. A few residents and passers-by nearby claim to have seen a silver meteor, but how much of it is true and where the after-the-fact fantasy begins, who can say."

Chachamaru"Whatever it is, nobody clearly saw the actual slaughter, right?"

童心"So it is, so it is."

獅子吼"What kind of absurd story is this...!"

Chachamaru"Not absurd at all. Everyone who saw it is dead, that is all."

獅子吼"And where, precisely, is that not absurd?"

Chachamaru"Ahaha. Fair, fair. Totally absurd."

Raichou"...This is no time to be laughing."

Chachamaru"What else is left but laughing, yaar? Anybody would, I think."

Chachamaru"That rumor is already all over Kanto, you know: a full company of warriors wiped out by Silver Star. Citizens have settled at half-believing, half-not."

Chachamaru"Now suppose that is actually a lie."

Chachamaru"Suppose it was never a company. It was a BATTALION. Once you hear that, what can you do except laugh?"

Raichou"..."

獅子吼"True. Fifty-odd warriors annihilated by one rider. That belongs to ancient myth or a madman’s delusion, nothing else."

童心"Overlord Xiang of the China legends all over again. Arre, how did such a thing come out into the living world?"

Raichou"What is that thing, really...?"

Chachamaru"—It is the end, it is extinction, it is a vanishing that leaves not even ash. Thou shalt not touch, thou shalt not see, if thou dost not wish to perish..."

Raichou"What is that?"

Chachamaru"Gospel of Matthew, separate record. A passage of the Descending Demon King."

Raichou"...Hmm..."

Chachamaru"Lie."

Raichou"IT WAS A LIE?!"

Chachamaru"Pfft! Raichou believed it! There is always one like this. Say something that sounds fancy and they swallow it whole, then go preach it elsewhere and die of shame."

Raichou"I will kill you..."

童心"Now, now."

獅子吼"Your Highness, this is a grave matter after all. The present countermeasure team is not enough. We should expand it, put one of us in charge, and respond in earnest."

護氏"Hm..."

Chachamaru"He ignored it so smoothly, but he believed it for a second too, I bet. Good for you, Raichou. You have company!"

Raichou"Fools get ignored. Hmph."

護氏"Doushin. What is your view of Shishiku’s proposal?"

童心"Hmm. That it will become necessary in time, I cannot deny. But the timing..."

獅子吼"You say it is premature."

童心"Just so. For the shogunate to pour such strength into an unknown outlaw, at this stage, probably..."

護氏"It would fan the embers. The anti-shogunate elements among the people. And GHQ..."

獅子吼"It would give an opening to enemies within and without. I am not unaware of that. But Silver Star is too great a calamity to ignore. Even at some sacrifice, should it not be crushed?"

童心"So it comes down to which we settle first: the enemy power, or the calamity... But Shishiku, do not forget that we are not the only ones suffering Silver Star’s damage."

獅子吼"..."

童心"The Occupation Army, Rokuhara’s main enemy, has taken considerable losses as well. Considering that, for us alone to step to the front and clean up this trouble now would be rather a poor bargain, would it not?"

獅子吼"...I see."

Raichou"But Doushin saab! If Rokuhara crushes the Silver Star that even GHQ cannot handle, what better appeal that only the shogunate has the power to rule Yamato?"

童心"There also, difficulty. Small effect: we exhaust ourselves for nothing. Large effect: we light a fire under the Occupation."

童心"They are waiting for complete control of Yamato. We strengthen our grip, and they politely overlook it? They will not. First Silver Star exhausts us, then GHQ's great army comes to the door... hmm. That picture I do not care to see."

Raichou"..."

護氏"Theek hai. I accept Doushin’s view. We shall meet the Silver Star problem with the present arrangement. The responsible department will be expanded in time, but that is a task for after my rule is complete."

獅子吼"Ha..."

童心"As you command."

Raichou"As Father commands."

護氏"...Dissatisfied, Shishiku?"

獅子吼"Not at all. Only one point troubles me greatly."

護氏"Say it."

獅子吼"...Silver Star has not once been caught on the radar of the Kanto air-defense perimeter. Therefore it is reasonable to judge that it does not come from outside Kanto."

Raichou"Could it be fooling the radar by flying low? ...No, that cannot be. If so, someone would have seen it with plain eyes."

Chachamaru"So it appears from somewhere in Kanto and goes back somewhere in Kanto. If the radar covered all of Kanto instead of only its outer edge, this would be easy, na."

童心"Staff and expenses will not stretch to that. Unless the radar itself is improved, there is little we can do... As it stands, placing it at key points is all we manage."

獅子吼"True, a radar watching all of Kanto closely would make this easy. But even without one, the matter should already have been settled. Because warriors stand out."

獅子吼"Your Highness, this is the point I cannot accept."

護氏"Hm..."

獅子吼"There are a few past reports of it being seen taking off from crime scenes. But not once has anyone seen it landing. That is very strange."

童心"...Hmm. The explosion and exhaust trail of a warrior landing can be seen from quite far away. And yet..."

Raichou"Is it not just landing deep in some remote mountains?"

獅子吼"And how many such remote mountains does Kanto possess? A few, yes. Those very few have already had the countermeasure team searching them thoroughly."

獅子吼"No result. Not a trace found."

Raichou"..."

護氏"Doushin. What do you think?"

童心"I do not know. Shishiku’s argument is quite reasonable, and certainly suspicious. But the opponent is a monster beyond common sense. Perhaps it should not be measured with an ordinary ruler."

護氏"Hm..."

Chachamaru"Really? Maybe it is a pretty simple story."

Raichou"You just stay quiet already."

Chachamaru"Okaaay."

獅子吼"..."

童心"..."

獅子吼"Chachamaru. Is that statement based on some evidence?"

Chachamaru"Mngh. Castella is so good."

獅子吼"Listen!"

Chachamaru"...Either this castle, or the main camp of the four of us Kubo. Or else..."

Chachamaru"Hmmm..."

Chachamaru"Castella really has to be from Bunmeido..."

獅子吼"Eat or talk, pick one."

Chachamaru"Then eat."

獅子吼"TALK!"

Chachamaru"Isn’t it GHQ?"

獅子吼"..."

童心"...Hmm. I see. Warriors coming, warriors going—the Occupation headquarters at Yokohama has plenty of that traffic."

童心"Even if one Silver Star also came and went among that lot, an outsider would see nothing strange..."

Chachamaru"Actually, suppose GHQ is behind it. Then our whole starting point—takes off in Kanto, lands in Kanto—maybe that itself is no use."

Chachamaru"Maybe the Silver Star incidents are GHQ testing a new weapon?"

獅子吼"...A Stealth Draco. If so, its base is probably at sea, where concealment is better."

Chachamaru"Yes?"

Raichou"The Occupation Army suffers from Silver Star too. How do you explain that?"

en:
Chachamaru"...Huh? What is this, why are you acting so innocent now?"

Raichou"W-what...?"

Chachamaru"First lesson in conspiracy: play the victim yourself, suspicion goes elsewhere. We would also do it, no? Without any difficulty."

Raichou"..."

獅子吼"Ha. Naturally. One who killed parents and siblings to seize the headship speaks with authority."

Chachamaru"You are hardly one to talk. ...And besides, the mighty Britain is never short of men and machines."

Chachamaru"Two or three hundred nameless soldiers lost—what will it cost them? Nothing that hurts. And for that price, new weapon tested, public order spoiled, shogunate's control worn down. Three benefits, one small loss."

Chachamaru"For them it must be such a bargain they cannot stop laughing."

Raichou"...I suppose... true..."

獅子吼"There is something in it. At this stage it is only speculation, though..."

Chachamaru"Right? Can apun eat castella now?"

獅子吼"Do as you like. ...Your Highness, how shall we proceed?"

童心"Chachamaru’s account lacks clear grounds, but much of it is convincing. If true, leaving it alone is dangerous..."

護氏"No. There is no change of policy."

護氏"Even if everything is the Occupation’s scheme, in fact all the more so, what must be dealt with first is GHQ itself. Caught up in the movement of fingertips, one loses sight of the whole."

護氏"Crush the root called GHQ and the branches wither soon enough. Do not forget. Our enemy lies in Yokohama. Our one desire is—"

護氏"THE GREAT EXPULSION OF THE BARBARIANS!"

童心"As you command. For Rokuhara!"

獅子吼"For divine Yamato!"

Raichou"For Father’s rule beneath heaven!"

Chachamaru"As expected of Grandpa. Yum yum."

Raichou"Read the room! How long are you going to keep eating that castella?!"

Chachamaru"Thanks for the meal. Anyway, changing the subject—"

Raichou"And now she is running the meeting..."

Chachamaru"Ah, you are noisy. Do not disturb the atmosphere. Listen when others are talking."

Raichou"Ggh..."

童心"An important agenda?"

Chachamaru"Not really. Something that has lately started getting talked about in town."

Chachamaru"It is about a ‘Red Warrior’. Heard of it?"

獅子吼"...No."

童心"Silver, and next red, is it? What is this?"

Chachamaru"Helps the weak, crushes the strong. A hero who fights under the banner of justice."

Raichou"...Haaah?"

Chachamaru"Or so I hear."

Raichou"That tells me nothing at all. What does that one actually do?"
ja:

「……はぁ？

雷蝶
「な、なによ……？」

雷蝶

en:
Chachamaru"Like I said, helps the weak and righteous, goes around smacking the strong and evil. That is what heroes do."

Raichou"Who are the evil ones?"

Chachamaru"Us, Rokuhara. And those ‘operatives’ too."

護氏"...You say there is a warrior going about hunting warriors who harm the people?"

Chachamaru"Yep. Shows up from nowhere, knocks down bad warriors, leaves for nowhere. Only a rumor, mind you."

Chachamaru"An urban legend, really?"

Raichou"...Of course. We have received no such report—"

獅子吼"...Not none. Among dragoon deaths processed as accidents, there are several with many suspicious points."

獅子吼"They were disposed of as private duels or Silver Star’s work, without distinction... but if this red warrior exists, some of the victims may be that one’s."

童心"...Hmm. Or perhaps... the magistrate of the destroyed village I reported earlier fell to the blade of this hero."

Raichou"Was that not Silver Star?"

童心"Ah, that is the thing, Raichou. It was the day before the village was destroyed..."

童心"A message came to my Koga headquarters from that magistrate. An unaffiliated warrior in crimson armor had appeared, and was committing treason in league with a GHQ inspector, he said."

護氏"Oh?"

童心"So he requested reinforcements. But I was in a whirl with the Okabe rebellion, with no time to deal with it properly, and I simply ignored it."

獅子吼"With respect, Doushin. Even so, ignoring a report alleging treason is somewhat of a lapse."

Raichou"...You, vassal’s vassal! Mind your position when you speak!"

童心"No, no, quite right. Answer I have none. Much reflection is taking place. Only, in my defense, that was not my sole reason for letting it pass."

獅子吼"Namely?"

童心"That magistrate had long been fixated on some mountain at his post. According to ancient documents, gems come out of it by the heap, so it must be developed, he petitioned again and again."

童心"Permission would not come, so finally he spent his own money and started digging. A rather... particular fellow. In a fight, useful enough."

獅子吼"...Was he trying to score points to rise at the center? Even so, there were better ways."

童心"Who can say? Now there is no asking him. Anyhow, the fellow's peculiarities were well known. In Koga, nobody gave that report much weight. There you have it."

Chachamaru"Hmm."

Raichou"A red warrior, huh..."

護氏"An interesting story. But... Doushin?"

童心"Ha. For now it is dream or reality, nobody knows. No need to worry. Besides..."

童心"If this red warrior is truly cutting down those operatives, GHQ finds that one even more irritating than we do. They will probably deal with it."

護氏"Shishiku."

獅子吼"I agree with Doushin. Still, the background to such rumors spreading, the rising longing for heroes among the citizens, does give me some concern."
ja:
茶々丸
「だから、弱くて正しいやつを助けて強くて

　ヒーローってのはそーいうもんだし」



雷蝶
「悪いやつって誰よ？」



茶々丸
「あてら六波羅。
　それと、例の工作員・・・ども」



護氏
「……民衆を害する武者を、狩って回る武者

茶々丸
「そそ。どこからともなく現れて、悪い武者

そーな。

茶々丸

雷蝶

獅子吼

獅子吼

童心
「……ふむぅ。あるいは……

雷蝶
「あれは銀星号なのでしょう？」



童心
「いや、それがですな、雷蝶殿。

童心
「それがしの古河公方府にその代官から連絡
がありまして。真紅の劔冑を駆る所属不明の
武者が現れただの、そやつがＧＨＱの巡察官

護氏
「ほう……？」



童心
「だから増援をくれという要請だったのです

獅子吼
「失礼ながら童心殿。
　仮にも反逆を訴える通報に対して、それは

雷蝶
「……この、陪臣上がり！

童心
「いやいや、まったくその通りで、返す言葉
もござらん。それがしも反省することしきり。

しまった理由は他にもござってなァ」



獅子吼
「とは？」



童心
「その代官がのぅ。前々から、赴任地のなん
とかいう山に固執して、大昔の古文書による
とここは宝石がわんさか出る場所だから是非
にも開発すべし、と再三上申を繰り返し」



童心
「それが通らんと知ると、とうとう自費で穴
を掘り始めよった、なんというか……変物で
のぉ。
　武人としては使える男であったのだが」



獅子吼
「……中央で出世するための点数稼ぎがした
かったのか？
　それにしても術があろうに」



童心
「さてなァ。今となってはわかり申さぬ。

ということは皆知っておったので、古河では
誰も報告を真に受けなかったという次第よ」



茶々丸
「ふーん」



雷蝶
「赤い武者、ねぇ……」



護氏
「興味深い話ではあるな。
　が……童心坊？」



童心
「は。今のところは夢とも現うつつとも知れぬ話、
気に病むには及びますまい。
　それに……」

童心
「赤い武者とやらが真、工作員・・・どもを斬って
回っているのなら。
　我ら以上にそやつが鬱陶しくてならぬのは
ＧＨＱ。連中が始末してくれるでござろう」



護氏
「獅子吼」



獅子吼
「童心殿に賛同仕ります。
　ただ、このような噂が広まる背景、市民の
間の英雄願望の高まりには若干の危惧を覚え
ないでもありません」

en:
童心"...It means that dissatisfaction has built up. But in the present situation, we cannot loosen our hold on the people..."

獅子吼"Just so. Rather, we should strengthen the police system of the Kamakura Oban and root out dissident elements more thoroughly."

護氏"Approved. Raichou, arrange it swiftly. Give orders to the Umayashu as well. Control from both the front and the back."

Raichou"Yes, Father."

Chachamaru"Unyaaa. Boring. Grandpa, shall we finish soon?"

護氏"...True. If there is no other agenda, today’s council ends here..."

童心"One moment, my lord. Shishiku, what about that matter?"

獅子吼"..."

Raichou"What matter?"

Chachamaru"...Ah, aaah. About succession to the main Ootori house, something about wanting approval. Right, you did say that."

Chachamaru"What happened with it?"

獅子吼"...That matter. Another day."

童心"...Hmm?"

Raichou"What is it? Did you find the legitimate main-line heir you were so fixated on? Or what, have you changed your mind after all, decided to marry Hanae and take the main house?"

獅子吼"...!"

Raichou"J-joke! There is no need to glare like that!"

Chachamaru"Bad mood, no? Something nasty must have happened."

獅子吼"..."

護氏"...Hm. I do not know the details, but if it is inconvenient, I shall not ask."

護氏"Let us take it up another day."

獅子吼"I am grateful for your arrangement... I am obliged."

護氏"That is all for tonight. You have all served well. You may withdraw."

童心"Ha!"

Chachamaru"Oh, right. Grandpa, is Tokio doing well?"

獅子吼"It is not Tokio, Chachamaru. His Highness’s legitimate grandson, Tokiomaru, has already come of age and bears the name Shirou Kuniuji."

獅子吼"At least call him Lord Shirou."

Chachamaru"Eeeh. Who cares. Coming of age, coming to seppuku, whatever—Tokio is Tokio."

獅子吼"You..."

護氏"Enough, Shishiku. To Shirou, Chachamaru is like an elder sister."

護氏"She is his only relative close to his age. He said he was lonely, as they have not met much lately. If you can, look in on him."

Chachamaru"Sure. I promised to lend him books, too. I will stop by before heading home. No harm buttering up the next High Commander."

護氏"Heh. Do not spoil him too much. He lost his parents early, poor child, but he must grow up well."

Chachamaru"Okaaay."

Raichou"..."

Chachamaru"Hm? Why the sour face? Uncle Raichou?"

Raichou"N-nothing, really..."

童心"...Hmm."

茶々丸

雷蝶

雷蝶
「べっ、別に……」



童心

en:
A day in the detention center is ruled by boredom.

Prison is another arrangement. There, the sentence is already settled. In a detention center they keep the unsentenced, plus those condemned prisoners who are treated as unsentenced (for them only one punishment is waiting, the final one, death, and nothing else), so forced labor is not done here.

On paper, a prisoner may volunteer for work. Permission exists; the arrangements do not. At Kanto Detention Center, therefore, the permitted request cannot be granted. Such was the guard's explanation.

Outside, in the open air, I may move about for thirty minutes per day. Only. All the remaining hours must be spent in silence inside the cell.

Reading and writing are allowed, but with limits. Neither will dispose of a whole long day.

So two options are left. Sleep without end. Alternatively—if one objects to sleeping one's body and mind into deterioration—take whatever exercise slightly more than two tatami will allow.

Loud noise is naturally not allowed. Equipment is also not allowed, even if you manufacture it from things already lying in the cell. Depending on the guard, even rubbing the body with a dry towel is read as preparation for strangling.

Practice swings are out of the question. Martial forms only scratch the guards' already frayed nerves for no benefit. In the end, what is possible is the standard muscle work: push-ups, sit-ups, back extensions.

In other words, exactly what I was doing at that moment.
ja:
拘置所の一日は退屈によって支配される。

　既に刑の確定した者のための施設である刑務所とは
異なり、拘置所に収容されるのは未決囚と未決囚扱い
の死刑囚（彼らに与えられるべき刑罰は最後の死のみ
であり、他には無い）なので、強制労働は行われない。

　規定の上では志願すれば労役に就くことも可能な筈
だが、この関東拘置所はその体制が整っていないため、
要望に応えることは不可能――とのことだった。
　看守からそう聞いている。

　外に出て体を動かせるのは一日あたり三十分間だけ。
　他の時間は全て独房内で静かに過ごさねばならない。

　読書や書き物は可能だが、制限がつく。
　長い一日を潰すのは無理だ。

　となれば後は、ひたすらに寝て過ごすか、あるいは
――貪眠による心身機能の低下を受容できないのなら
ば――二畳余の空間で許される限りの運動を行うしか
ない。

　派手な音を立てる行為は当然、認められない。
　器具を使うような運動も無論――例え獄室内にある
物で間に合わせるとしても。乾布摩擦でさえ、看守に
よっては絞殺の準備とみられる。

　素振りなどは論外。体術の型なども看守のささくれ
立った神経をいたずらに刺激するのみだ。
　結局のところ、出来ることは腕立て、腹筋、背筋と
いったスタンダードな筋トレの類に限られる。

　つまりは、俺が今している事もそれなのだった。

en: ｅｔｃ／看守"Unsentenced prisoner number zero-four-eight."
ja:
[text0020a]

ｅｔｃ／看守
「未決囚〇四八号」

en:
Kageaki"Ji."

ｅｔｃ／看守"Notice has come. For questioning, you are being moved temporarily to Kamakura Police Station. The car is already here. You have ten minutes to get ready."

Kageaki"Understood."

ｅｔｃ／看守"...By the way, you."

Kageaki"Yes?"

ｅｔｃ／看守"What were you doing just now?"

Kageaki"Push-ups."

ｅｔｃ／看守"...Push-ups. I see."

Kageaki"Yes."

ｅｔｃ／看守"Where were you born?"

Kageaki"Nagasaki."

ｅｔｃ／看守"I am from Akita."

Kageaki"I hear the kiritanpo is excellent."

ｅｔｃ／看守"And Nagasaki has champon."

Kageaki"Yes."

ｅｔｃ／看守"...In my hometown, for push-ups we put both hands and both feet on the ground."

Kageaki"Generally, yes."

ｅｔｃ／看守"Push-up with the feet in the air, this is the first time I am seeing."

Kageaki"I have seldom observed anyone else doing them either."

ｅｔｃ／看守"Is it not painful?"

Kageaki"I writhe in agony."

ｅｔｃ／看守"...Good. That is a relief, actually."

Kageaki"I am glad to hear it."

ｅｔｃ／看守"Chalo, get ready."

Kageaki"Ji."
ja:
[text0020b]

景明
「はい」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「事情聴取のため、お前を一時的に鎌倉署へ
移送するとの通達があった。迎えの車はもう
来ている。
　一〇分以内に支度をしろ」



景明
「わかりました」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「……ところで、お前」



景明
「何でしょうか」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「今、何をしていた？」



景明
「腕立て伏せです」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「……そうか。
　腕立て伏せか」



景明
「はい」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「お前、生まれは？」



景明
「長崎です」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「俺は秋田だ」



景明
「きりたんぽが美味しいとか」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「長崎は、ちゃんぽんだな」



景明
「ええ」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「……俺の故郷では、腕立て伏せってのは、
両手と両足を地面につけてやるもんだった」



景明
「大概は、そうでしょう」



ｅｔｃ／看守
「足を浮かせてやる腕立て伏せっていうのは
初めて見た」



景明
「自分も、他人がやるのはあまり見た覚えが

ｅｔｃ／看守
「苦しくないのか？」



景明
「苦しみ悶えます」



ｅｔｃ／看守

en:
Chief"...So. There is no mistake."

Kageaki"None. That village was destroyed by Silver Star."
ja:
署長
「……つまり。
　間違いはないのだな」



景明
「はい。
　あの村は銀星号が滅ぼしました」

en:
I pick up the tea bowl from the table. The faint fragrance tickling my nose is new tea from Enshu. The color gives away its low price. Its quality, however, is not bad.

I tilt the bowl only until the surface touches my lips, and wet the tip of my tongue.
ja:
卓上の茶碗を手に取る。
　鼻をくすぐるほのかな香りは、遠州産の新茶のそれ
だった。色を見れば安物とわかるが、品質は悪くない。

　水面が唇に触れる程度に碗を傾け、舌先を湿らせる。

en:
Kageaki"Muramasa holds the same view. Or rather... not one person escaped. It was total annihilation, literally. There is no room for misunderstanding."

Chief"Correct. Take the military meaning first. A unit loses the ability to function; we call it annihilated. The actual losses? Thirty to forty percent."

Chief"Annihilated, yet sixty percent survive. Nothing strange in that. But meet that thing, and even that sixty percent are not allowed to live."

Kageaki"Because it is not war. Between attacker and victim there is no such thing as combat, that lukewarm playful negotiation."

Kageaki"It is simply a natural disaster. A great tsunami hitting a coastal village. A great eruption hitting a village at the foot of the mountain. Survivors are not permitted to exist."
ja:
景明
「村正も同様の見解です。というより……
　ただの一人も逃れ得なかった、文字通りの
全滅・・なのです。誤解の余地がありません」



署長
「その通りだな。
　例えば軍事用語で全滅と云うとき、部隊が
機能を完全に失うほどの損害を受けた状態を
指す。比率にして三割から四割程度」

署長
「全滅といっても六割は無事に生きている。
それが常識というものだ。
　しかしあれ・・に遭遇した者には、その六割の
生存が許されない」



景明
「あれは戦争ではないので。
　加害者と被害者との間に、戦闘などという、
生温いお遊戯めいた交渉は存在しません」

景明
「単なる天災です。
　沿岸の村を襲う大津波です。
　山麓の村を襲う大噴火です。
　生き残りなど許される筈がない」

en:
A fact I state as a fact. No reply came.

On the east wall of the not-so-large room hangs one painting. Mulberry cultivation: an entirely ordinary landscape. Nothing in the technique calls for particular admiration either. As a matter of taste, however, I liked it.

It is not the work of any famous person. Not even a painter's. The owner of this room painted it himself. Maybe because it is ordinary, it has a quality that settles the viewer. ...Maybe I am being partial.

That painting is the only thing in this room one could call decoration. The rest is practical furniture, many documents, and assorted things with no taste and no charm.

For the head of the police station that is supposed to keep Kamakura's peace, a lonely arrangement. With a little more ambition in the matter of irony, I might call it deplorable.

Or realistic.

The realistic chief of this realistic office takes his eyes off the grain of the table and looks at me again.
ja:
事実を事実として言い切る。
　返答はなかった。

　広くもない室内の東側の壁に、絵が一幅、飾られて
いる。桑の栽培の様子を描いた、ごくごく平凡な風景
画だ。技術的にも見るべき点は特にないだろう。
　だが好悪を問うなら、好みだった。

　著名人の作品ではない。いや、画家の手になるもの
でさえない。それはこの部屋の主の、自筆だった。
　凡庸な作品だからこそと言うべきか、見る人を落ち
着かせるような趣がある。……贔屓目かもしれないが。

　そんな絵だけが、この部屋にあって唯一、装飾品と
呼べるものだった。
　後は実用本位の家具と多くの資料類、味も素っ気も
ない諸々があるばかりだ。

　鎌倉市の治安を預かる――べき――警察署の首長が
座すにしては、寂しい佇まいだと言えた。
　もう少し皮肉な表現力を駆使するなら、嘆かわしい・・・・・
佇まいだと評することも可能かもしれない。

　あるいは現実的・・・か。
　現実的な署長室の現実的な警察署長は、テーブルの
木目に向けていた視線を外し、再びこちらを見やって
いる。

en:
Chief"You stopped the ‘egg’ from hatching."

Kageaki"Yes. We confirmed that Ukyo Nagasaka, the Rokuhara magistrate, and his mercenary Kotaro Fuma were both hosts. I killed them both."

Chief"At present, that is the most vital point. Let that thing multiply, and where will we be?"

Chief"Good work."

Kageaki"No. The one who suffered was never me."

Chief"...Hm. Did you get any information on Silver Star?"

Kageaki"Nothing from Ukyo Nagasaka. Kotaro Fuma seems to have had some conversation-level contact with it, but nothing meaningful, like its location, was obtained."

Chief"I see. Somebody, somewhere, must be protecting it. That is how it should be viewed, but..."

Kageaki"Without that assumption, the facts do not balance."

Chief"A nationwide search is out for it as a missing person, and still nothing catches. Police weakness may be one reason, but..."

Chief"Two years now. Some supporter must be there; that is the conclusion to draw."

Kageaki"Quite so. But the purpose I cannot guess at all. Who would lend a hand to a killer who harms everyone, and why?"

Chief"Exactly. The logic will not hold, will it? ...Unfortunately, the world does a great deal of business without consulting logic."

Kageaki"In that case, to approach the truth by logical inference alone is difficult."

Chief"Correct. Sit comfortably, play detective—nothing will come of it."

Chief"Decisive information is needed. Sorry to ask, but I am counting on you, Kageaki."

Kageaki"Understood. Separately, one more matter is bothering me."

Chief"What is it?"

Kageaki"The man who supplied Kotaro Fuma with sword-armor. Name, Ichizo Sorimachi. He belongs to the Nogiyama Group, which Rokuhara employs, and he is also an errand boy for GHQ."

Chief"Ah..."

Kageaki"If I swallow every word I was told, Fuma got back sword-armor that GHQ had seized, through Sorimachi's arrangements. Why was such a thing permitted?"

Kageaki"The results of GHQ's sword-armor-hunting policy must surely be under strict seal. Otherwise, all the trouble of hunting and collecting sword-armor has no meaning."

Chief"...The teacher from the other day. Ryoubu Suzukawa. He also had sword-armor of unknown origin, didn't he?"

Kageaki"Yes. A connection is suspected."

Chief"How do you see it?"

Kageaki"...The reasonable inference would be: GHQ takes no interest in Yamato; the Occupation Army's discipline consequently slackens; supplies are easily diverted. Something of that order."

Chief"And the marks? Grade your own answer."

Kageaki"Fail."

Chief"Why?"

Kageaki"Is GHQ indifferent to Yamato?"

Chief"No. ...Yes, exactly that."

Chief"I already have a conjecture on this matter. But we will talk tomorrow. It will come up anyway, and I do not want to say this kind of thing many times."

Kageaki"Tomorrow?"

Chief"Rest tonight at my official residence. You need not go back to the detention center. Tomorrow, after work, there is a place I want you to accompany me."

Kageaki"Where to?"

Chief"Hachimangu. His Imperial Highness wishes to meet you."

Kageaki"..."

Kageaki"Why is that?"

Chief"His Highness worries about you more than you think. He takes the Silver Star affair, which harms so many citizens, as his own burden."

Chief"He expects much of you. For some time now, in fact, he has wanted to speak with you in person."

Kageaki"But. A body drenched in the pollution of blood, before the imperial house—"

Chief"His Highness is not a man to fuss over such petty things."

Kageaki"I do not think it petty. Those who preside over the altars of the state should stay far from impurity."

Chief"Now, do not make it difficult. His Highness is a practical man. He wants the facts from someone who was there. For that, who is there but you?"

Chief"That is all. So no need to charm anybody. Just answer His Highness's questions about the case."

Chief"Not quite an hour. Supply that much patience and come along."

Kageaki"...Understood."
ja:
署長
「〝卵〟の孵化は阻止したのだな」



景明
「はい。
　六波羅代官長坂右京とその傭兵風魔小太郎
が寄生体であることを確認、両名を殺害しま
した」



署長
「現状で何よりも肝要なのはそこだ。
　あんなものに増え・・られては堪らん」



署長
「御苦労だったな」



景明
「いいえ。
　苦しんだのは決して、自分ではありません
から」



署長
「…………。
　銀星号について情報は得られたか？」



景明
「長坂右京からは何も。
　風魔小太郎の方はあれ・・と会話程度の接触は
した様子ですが、所在などの有意義な情報は
やはり得られませんでした」



署長
「そうか。
　あれは何処かに、何者かが、保護・・している
とみるべきなのだが……」



景明
「そう考えなくては、理屈に合いません」



署長
「失踪者扱いで全国に捜索を手配しているに
も拘わらず、まるで引っ掛からないのだから
な。
　警察力の不足もあるだろうが……」



署長
「もう二年にもなる。
　支援者がいると考えるべきだ」



景明
「全くに。しかし、目的が皆目わかりません。
　誰もを害する殺戮者に、誰がどうして手を
貸すのか」



署長
「ああ。筋道が通らんな？
　……そして世の中、筋道の通らん話が割合
横行するから困る」



景明
「であれば、論理的推察のみによって真実へ
近付くのは難しいという事になります」



署長
「その通りだ。
　安楽椅子の探偵を気取っていてもどうにも
ならん」

署長
「決定的な情報が要る。
　済まないが宜しく頼むぞ、景明」



景明
「承知しています。
　ところで。それとは別件で一つ、気になる
事柄が」



署長
「なんだ？」



景明
「風魔小太郎に劔冑を提供した男です。
　名は雪車町一蔵。六波羅御雇の野木山組に
属し、且つＧＨＱの御用聞きでもある」



署長
「ああ……」



景明
「自分が聞かされた話をすべて鵜呑みにする
なら、という前提ですが――風魔はＧＨＱに
奪われた劔冑を雪車町の手配りで取り戻して
いる。何故、そのような真似が許されたのか」

景明
「ＧＨＱの〝劔冑狩り〟政策の成果は当然、
厳重に封印されている筈。
　でなければ、手間隙を費やして劔冑を狩り
集めた意味がありません」



署長
「…………。
　先日の教師。鈴川令法か。彼も出所不明の
劔冑を持っていたのだったな」



景明
「はい。
　関連性が疑われます」



署長
「お前はどう考えている？」



景明
「……妥当な推論をするなら。
　ＧＨＱの大和への無関心が進駐軍の綱紀を
緩ませ、物資の横流しを安易に行わせている
――というあたりでしょう」



署長
「その推論に対する自己採点は？」



景明
「不可」



署長
「なぜ？」



景明
「ＧＨＱは大和に無関心ですか？」



署長
「否。
　……そう、そういうことだな」



署長
「この件については既に推測を持っている。
　だが、明日話そう。どうせ話題になる……
こんな話は幾度も口にしたくない」



景明
「明日？」



署長
「今日は私の役宅で休んでおけ。拘置所には
戻らなくていい。
　明日、仕事が済んだ後で付き合って欲しい
所がある」



景明
「どちらへ」



署長
「八幡宮だ。
　親王殿下がお前に会いたがっておられる」



景明
「…………」



景明
「それはまた、何故」



署長
「お前が思っている以上に、殿下はお前の事
を気に掛けておられるよ。
　殿下は国民を多く害する銀星号事件を我が
身の事として考えておいでだ」

署長
「お前にかける期待も大きい。
　一度親しく言葉を交わしたいと、実は前々
から仰せであった」



景明
「しかし。
　血の穢れに塗れた身を皇族の御前には――」



署長
「そんなつまらん事にこだわられる殿下では
ない」



景明
「つまらぬ事とは思われません。
　社稷を司る者は不浄を遠ざけるべき」



署長
「まあ、そう言うな。
　要は実際的な方なのだよ、殿下は。事件の
実情を知るために現場の者の声を聞きたいと
望んでおられる。となればお前しかいない」

署長
「それだけだ。だから別に、愛想を振りまく
必要もない。
　事件について殿下の御下問にお答えすれば
済む」



署長
「小一時間ほどの辛抱だ。我慢して付き合え」



景明
「……わかりました」

en:
I nod, since I have no choice. A heavy matter, but once it is put like this, nothing else can be done.

—The prince at Hachimangu. I had heard the rumor that he is an oddball of the imperial family; apparently the rumor is true, or even an understatement. A noble who wants to meet a prisoner, such a thing I have never heard.

...I only hope he does not question me down to every last particular.

I drain the bowl, which gives no steam now. Tea that has lost its warmth is needlessly bitter.
ja:
やむなく首肯する。
　気の重い話だが、そう言われては仕方がなかった。

　――八幡宮の親王。
　皇室の変わり種という風評はこれまでにも耳にして
いたが、どうやら噂通りあるいは噂以上の人物らしい。
　獄囚に会いたがる貴人など聞いたこともない。

　……あまり根掘り葉掘りあれこれと聞かれなければ
良いが。

　既に湯気など立てない茶碗を呷る。
　温かみを失った茶は無闇に苦かった。

en:
We leave Kamakura Police Station by the staff gate, and come out onto the street.

The chief has personally come to see me off. I am grateful for the kindness, but I worry about the eyes of people. A police chief seeing off a detainee is a strange picture.

Then again, the chief is in police uniform, while I am not wearing detention-center clothes. I knew the worry was useless.
ja:
職員用の通用門から鎌倉署の外へ。
　通りへ出る。

　署長はわざわざ見送りをしてくれた。厚情は有難い
が、人目を思って気に病みもする。
　警察署長が拘置囚を送っているのだから異様な図だ。

　とはいえ署長は警察の制服姿だが、こちらは拘置所
の囚人服を着ているわけではない。
　無用の心配だとはわかっていた。

en:
Chief"If nothing happens, I will return to the residence before sunset tomorrow. Until then, make yourself comfortable."

Kageaki"Yes. May I use the study?"

Chief"As you like. ...Oh yes, there is a research book in it, summarizing the eugenics of the Germany."

Kageaki"That interests me. I will read it tonight itself. Then, until tomorrow."

Chief"Yes—hm?"
ja:
署長
「何事も無ければ、明日は日暮れ前に役宅へ
戻る。それまではくつろいでいろ」



景明
「はい。
　書斎を使っても構いませんか」



署長
「好きにしろ。
　……ああ、そういえば統合帝国ドイツの優生学に
ついてまとめた研究書が入っている」



景明
「それは関心があります。今夜にでも読んで
おきましょう。
　では」



署長
「ああ――
　ん？」

en:
The chief's gaze suddenly drifts. Behind me, diagonally to the right.

Following it, I turn.

There is a figure.

Leaning her back on the concrete wall, she watches us sideways, head slightly lowered. At first sight, an indifferent attitude. But behind the eyes there is a fierce will.

As she was always, as far as I know.

A face strongly printed on my memory. Remembering her full name cost me no effort.
ja:
署長の視線がふと、泳ぐ。
　俺の後方、斜め右側へ。

　つられて追う。
　
　人影があった。

　コンクリート塀に背を預け、こちらをうつむき加減
の横目で窺っている。
　一見、何の気もなさそうな素ぶり。しかしその実、
眼球の奥には激しい意志の光があった。

　俺の知る限り、彼女がいつもそうであったように。

　脳裏に強く記憶されている顔だった。
　姓名を思い出すのに何の苦労もいらない。

en:
Ichijou"..."

Kageaki"..."

Chief"An acquaintance?"

Kageaki"Yes... Why are you here?"

Kageaki"Ichijou Ayane. Family name Ichijou, given name Ayane—"

Ichijou"THE OTHER WAY AROUND!!"

Kageaki"...My apologies."
ja:
一条
「…………」



景明
「…………」



署長
「知り合いか？」



景明
「ええ……。
　どうしてここに？」



景明
「一条綾弥さん」





一条
「逆だよっ!!」



景明
「…………失敬」

en: ガーゲット"Enter."
ja:
ガーゲット
「入れ」

en: Kanae"Lieutenant Kanae Ootori, and with her Sayo Nagakura, civilian employee with corporal's status. We have arrived and are reporting for duty."
ja:
[text0020a]

香奈枝
「大鳥香奈枝中尉、並びに伍長待遇軍属永倉
さよ。ただいま着任いたしました」

en:
Cannon"Good. Do I need to introduce myself also?"

Kanae"If time is troubling you by its abundance, certainly, Section Chief. Major General Willow furnished only the broadest outline."

Cannon"Then let me do it, since for once we are free. Yesterday, I tell you, was something: three whole hours of sleep. Three! And that Excellency of ours, whose energy never reached his scalp, must have given you only the roughest sketch. Am I right?"

Kanae"What was it he said... Sayo?"

Sayo"'Lieutenant, an assignment for you. Mata Hari! You have earned the honor of playing that historic spy's role in the League forces. I trust you are delighted. Dance training is not required.'"

Sayo"That is the entire briefing."

Cannon"That is a problem long before we ask whether it is enough or not enough. Though it does hit the center, I admit. So, what did the Lieutenant answer?"

Kanae"I said I lacked the confidence to play it as well as Greta Garbo."

Cannon"Hm. Yamato modesty, is it? Arre, I think the Lieutenant will go quite far. Much more charming than some Viking descendant dragged out of a peninsula backwater along with a dairy cow."

Kanae"Oh, such persuasive speech. I may believe it by accident; flattery is a weakness of mine. Only, before I rise to the occasion, a script would be helpful. Otherwise what is one to perform?"

Cannon"Right, right. One step at a time. Clive Cannon, head of Records Management, General Staff Section Two. But do not call me section chief. The sound brings me out in an irritation."

Cannon"Lieutenant Colonel will do. And this is my support."

ガーゲット"Major George Gargett. For matters connected to your duties, reports will mainly come to me. We will be meeting often."

ガーゲット"Many things may prove difficult. Still, we ought to work well together, would you not agree, Lieutenant?"

Kanae"I agree entirely. Please do guide me, Major Gargett."

ガーゲット"No handshake is necessary. Lieutenant Ootori, I said we should work well together. I did not say we should be friends."

Kanae"...Oh. My apologies."

Cannon"George?"

ガーゲット"Is there a problem, Lieutenant Colonel?"

Cannon"...Well. This is how he is made. Please do not take it to heart, Lieutenant."

Kanae"Please do not worry on my account. Nothing has been taken to heart. A trip to wash my hands afterward has also been saved."

ガーゲット"..."

Cannon"Hahaha. Good, good. Teamwork perfect already. Happiness only for me. Wait here a little; I will ask old man Willow for a transfer to Saipan."

ガーゲット"Please finish the briefing for Lieutenant Ootori first, Lieutenant Colonel."

Cannon"Yes, yes, Your Excellency the Major. Lady, I should also explain this Records Management Section briefly, I suppose."

Kanae"If possible. ...Lieutenant Colonel."

Cannon"Hm? That came out hard for you. Did you eat a raw lieutenant colonel as a child and get a stomach upset?"

Kanae"Well... until recently I had another lieutenant colonel to address. A certain indigestion on that account I cannot deny."

Cannon"Ah, that idiot Cobden."

ガーゲット"Lieutenant Colonel. That expression is rather too direct."

Cannon"Fine, then Cobden's chronic deficiency of education. Are you listening, Lieutenant? Actually he too lost his seat in Civil Affairs, around the same time as you."

Kanae"Oh. That is news to me. I had assumed he was promoted for the merit of removing a poor inspector."
ja:

en:
Cannon"That became his last job. Only the ending went wrong: demotion, not promotion. By now he must be torturing a new chair at the Yokosuka harbor base."

Kanae"A posting to a coastal resort. How I envy him. And what was the reason for this honorable promotion?"

Cannon"Bribery. A side business, taking small money from construction companies, smugglers, shogunate officials, in return for favors. He went at it with great enthusiasm, apparently."

Kanae"Oh dear. Ruined by overwork, poor man."

Cannon"The poor ones are the other Civil Affairs bigwigs. Thanks to him they must hold back their own side businesses for a while."

Cannon"A little consideration—hide the thing properly—and Audit need not do overtime. But no. The base telephone itself he uses. Then how are they to avoid catching him?"

Kanae"Wonderfully open, I think."

Cannon"On his way out of Civil Affairs, I hear the openness had become more of a slink. We have wandered."

Cannon"Lieutenant, what do you think our Records Management Section does?"

Kanae"Let me think. In my humble opinion, probably—"

Kanae"it manages records."

Cannon"Brilliant. Absolutely correct, Lieutenant Ootori. Never have I seen a talent like yours."

Kanae"Oh, thank you so much."

ガーゲット"..."

Cannon"Hey, George. Join the conversation."

ガーゲット"Yes, Lieutenant Colonel. I decline."

Cannon"...Well, that is true. Only one thing is missing."

Kanae"Yes?"

Cannon"We collect information and materials, then manage them. Collecting is the main business, actually. That is why nobody is ever in the office."

Cannon"Major General Willow named the section; collecting, it seems, slipped his mind. Now outsiders take us for men put out to pasture. Name he gives, nuisance we inherit."

Kanae"...I see. So that is why Mata Hari."

Cannon"Work with a little scope, you see? Only, my staff are terribly modest. Outside, they simply will not boast of what they do. The culture here is like that."

Cannon"Myself also, same modesty. So, Lieutenant Ootori, you must adjust to the culture. Teamwork, you understand. If adjustment is not possible, tell me early."

Cannon"That former superior whose good fortune you envied? I can arrange a triumphant return to his staff. Forms are ready also. Now tell me: what shall I do with them?"

Kanae"So much advance consideration; I am touched. But set your mind at rest. In matters of modesty, I consider myself quite unbeatable."

Cannon"OK, OK. Then no problem. How about it, Major Gargett? She will do first-class work, surely?"

ガーゲット"Yes, Lieutenant Colonel. I retain some doubt."

Cannon"Such as?"

ガーゲット"Lieutenant Ootori."

Kanae"Yes."

ガーゲット"In your previous assignment as inspector, you intervened in the internal governance of Yamato. Is there any error in that?"

Kanae"None."

ガーゲット"Regret or reflection?"

Kanae"None, Major Gargett."

ガーゲット"...Then, your explanation?"

キャノン

en:
Kanae"Same as above."

ガーゲット"...Lieutenant Colonel."

Cannon"Something wrong, Major?"

ガーゲット"It appears to me there is a substantial problem."

Cannon"Yes, there is a problem. But not the Lieutenant."

Cannon"The problem is the incompetent who kept talent like hers sitting idle. That is why such things happen. And that problem is already cleared, no? Of course it is. So the Lieutenant has no problem."

ガーゲット"However—"

Cannon"Lieutenant Ootori. No, Miss Kanae Ootori. I ask you as a person of Yamato."

Cannon"Russia or the Britain—which would you prefer as a friend?"

Kanae"..."

ガーゲット"..."

Kanae"A John Bull, I should think, is easier company than a polar bear. Would you not agree, Mister?"

Cannon"Very good. Very, very good. Britain proposed the International League for Unified Peace and Co-Prosperity; we at GHQ serve under that League. Then Yamato can get on very well with them—and with us."

Cannon"No more objection, Major Gargett?"

ガーゲット"...Sir. If the Lieutenant Colonel says so."

Cannon"Phew. A stiff superior is a nuisance, is it not, Lieutenant? I understand well, I have a stiff subordinate."

Kanae"Yes, Lieutenant Colonel Cannon. Though I cannot say I dislike the quality."

ガーゲット"I see. I, however, do not care for subordinates like you."

Kanae"How very disappointing."

Cannon"Not gentlemanly, George. Now, Lieutenant, you may go for today. But from tomorrow you will start work at once."

Kanae"Yes. What kind of assignment?"

Cannon"The order will be given orally tomorrow morning. The outline is in this file. Read it by tomorrow, and after reading, dispose of it according to military regulation."

Kanae"Yes. ......And this?"

Cannon"New rank insignia. Wear it from tomorrow. That is all, Captain Ootori."

Kanae"Ji."

Sayo"We take our leave."

en:
ガーゲット"..."

Cannon"Still something you want to say, Major Gargett?"

ガーゲット"Lieutenant Colonel Cannon. Do you sincerely believe that Yamato woman can be trusted?"

Cannon"Yamato woman. By race, yes, but she is not a Yamato citizen. She obtained nationality and military status in the Habsburg, and then entered the League forces."

ガーゲット"Lieutenant Colonel, that is not what I am speaking of."

Cannon"I know. But think like this, George: is she a fool?"

ガーゲット"No. She has the insidious calculating ability typical of the yellow race. Which is exactly why—"

Cannon"Then she will also calculate profit and loss, for herself and for Yamato. Remember her words? British gentleman over Russian bear. And that is quite correct."

Cannon"Bow to Russia and you become only a serf, as the present state of the former countries of Central Asia proves. The Rokuhara shogunate is out of the question, no?"

Cannon"She is hardly going to choose the wrong one of those three sides. Let us leave it at that. Afterwards... let me see."

ガーゲット"..."

Cannon"Let us hope she is not too clever. That is about all."

ガーゲット"...Still, I cannot—"

Cannon"Enough. Your concern I will keep in mind, Major."

ガーゲット"Sir."

Cannon"What matters is to know how each piece moves, and use it. An pawn goes one step forward. A bishop runs diagonally. Know this and it is enough."

Cannon"In that sense, she and that gaunt man are exactly the same. Isn't it?"

ガーゲット"...Yes. That I understand."

Cannon"Then that is that."

Cannon"...Still."

ガーゲット"Yes?"

Cannon"Willow with his big belly, and he chooses Mata Hari. Well chosen, I must say. You know the charge when France executed her was not simply spying."

Cannon"Double spying. That celebrated spy of European history was working for France and Germany both."

ガーゲット"..."

「彼女が賢過ぎない・・・・・ことを願おう。
　そんなところだ」



ガーゲット
「……やはり、自分には……」



キャノン
「もう言うな。
　少佐の懸念は胸に留めておく」



ガーゲット
「はっ」



キャノン
「重要なのは駒の動きを把握して使うことだ。
歩兵ポーンは前に一歩しか進めない。司教ビショップは斜めに
走る。そいつをわかっていればいい」

キャノン
「その意味で、彼女も、あの痩せこけた男も
全く同じことだ。
　そうじゃないか？」



ガーゲット
「……はい。
　それは理解できます」



キャノン
「なら、そういうことさ」

キャノン
「……それにしても」



ガーゲット
「はい」



キャノン
「ウィローの太鼓腹、マタ・ハリとはよくも
言ったもんだな。
　知ってるだろう？　彼女がフランスで処刑
された時の罪状は単なるスパイじゃない」

キャノン
「二重・・スパイだ。
　欧州史に名だたるかの売女は、フランスと
ドイツの双方に向けて足を開いていた」



ガーゲット
「…………」

en:
Hachimangu may be called the center of Kamakura. Geographically, historically, politically: on all three counts.

In Imperial Year 1723 (1063 by the foreign calendar), Yoriyoshi Minamoto, second head of the Seiwa-line Kawachi Genji, took his clan god Hachiman and enshrined him at Tsurugaoka, which was his own territory. About one hundred years later, his descendant Yoritomo opened the warrior capital Kamakura with Hachimangu in the middle.

Eight hundred years have passed since, and Kamakura's Hachimangu has stood as guardian deity of the Genji—no, of the warrior class as a whole. The Rokuhara clan, who today call themselves heads of the Genji, show it extraordinary devotion.

A regular visit several times a year is not enough for them. For every happy occasion and every unhappy one, a ceremony is held. Such an undertaking cannot help carrying the color of political publicity, so it grows grand, automatically. Frequent rebuilding and lavish decoration probably have the same reason. Beauty on the building is politics on the building.

And one more decoration of that type, you could say, is the person who was invited all the way from the capital in Kyoto and received in the inner hall.

Deep in the Hachimangu grounds stands one small, quiet hall... It is said that the Maidono which now stands near the center, was once on this very spot. Hence its second name, Inner Maidono.

The resident of the small hall takes his title from that tradition.
ja:
八幡宮は鎌倉の中心にあるといえる。
　地理的にも、歴史的にも、政治的にも。

　国紀一七二三（外暦一〇六三）年、清和系河内源氏
二代目棟梁にあたる源頼義が氏神たる八幡神を所領で
あった鶴岡に祀り――およそ百年後、彼の後裔頼朝は
八幡宮を中心に武家の都・鎌倉を開く。

　爾来八百年、鎌倉の八幡宮は源氏の守護神……否、
武士の守護神として在った。
　現代において源氏棟梁を称する六波羅一門も、並々
ならぬ崇敬を寄せている。

　年数回の定例参拝を行うのみならず、慶事凶事の折
につけ祭儀を催した。
　その種の事業は政治宣伝の色合いを帯びずにはいら
れない。勢い盛大なものになる。

　頻繁に改築を行い、豪奢な装いを調えることも理由
は同じだろう。美観上の装飾はつまり政治上の装飾。
　――言うなれば、その一つなのだ。はるばる京の都
から招かれ、奥殿へ迎えられたかの人物も。

　八幡宮境内の深部にひっそりと建つ小殿……
　現在は中央付近にある舞殿まいどのが、かつてはその場所に
あったと伝えられる。故に一名、奥舞殿。

　小殿の主が称する名はその伝承に由来した。

en:
Maidono-no-miya Haruhiro Shinno.

Youngest son of the late Emperor. In the line of succession he stands second, after Crown Prince Motohiro.

That he was installed as betto, the chief of Hachimangu's rites, proves—nothing else it can possibly prove—the depth of Rokuhara's faith and loyalty to the throne. Or so it was decided. On the surface.

In reality: a declaration of Rokuhara's authority, that it can move even the Imperial House as it pleases. And—nothing more than a hostage. Kyoto's human sacrifice to Rokuhara.

The shadow wavering beyond the bamboo blind was that kind of existence.
ja:
舞殿宮春煕親王まいどののみやはるひろしんのう。
　先帝の末子にあたり、皇位継承順位では基煕皇太子
に次ぐ第二位に位置する。

　彼が八幡宮の祭祀長職たる別当として奉じられた事
は、まさしく六波羅の信仰心と勤皇精神の厚かりしを
顕すものに他ならない。
　……ということに、されていた。表向きは。

　実際のところ。
　皇室をも自在に動かし得るという六波羅の権威表明
であり、そして――人質に過ぎない。
　京都が六波羅に差し出した人身御供。

　御簾の向こうにゆらめく影は、そうした存在だった。

en:
Chief"Your Highness. I have brought Kageaki Minato."

Kageaki"..."
ja:
署長
「宮殿下。
　湊斗景明を連れて参りました」



景明
「……」

en:
Behind the chief I lie flat and silent. I am supposedly a guest, in some sense, but guest or not, one cannot speak first to a member of the imperial house.

I wait for words to be handed down. Actually, there is no waiting to speak of.
ja:
署長の後方で無言のまま平伏する。
　一応客人という立場らしいが、であろうともまさか
皇族に対して先に声を掛けるわけにはいかない。

　言葉が下されるのを待つ。
　いや、待つほどのことはなかった。

en: 舞殿宮"Achha, you are Kageaki, then! Chief Kikuchi keeps telling me about you."
ja:
[text0050a]

舞殿宮
「おまさんが景明くんかぁー。
　菊池署長からよう聞いてるえぇ」

en:
舞殿宮"...What is it? What happened?"

Chief"Please do not mind, Your Highness. It is merely the kowtow greeting."

舞殿宮"Oh, that is it. Such manners this boy has. But relax a little, no? All this stiffness is not required."

Kageaki"Ji."
ja:
[text0050b]

舞殿宮
「……どないしたん？」



署長
「お気になさらず、宮殿下。
　単なる叩頭こうとう礼ですので」



舞殿宮
「ああ、そか。
　礼儀正しい子やなぁ。でも、そんなに固く
ならんでもええよ？」



景明
「はっ」

en:
I wish Your Highness would go a little stiffer himself.

I am not so ungrateful as to say this and trouble the chief. I only give thanks for the rescue—its quality as a rescue being doubtful—and lower my head again.
ja:
貴方はもう少し固くならないのですか。皇弟殿下。
　などと答えて署長を困らせるほど恩知らずではない
つもりだった。フォロー――としては疑問もあったが
――に感謝だけしつつ改めて頭を下げる。

en:
Kageaki"I receive Your Highness's words for the first time. Kageaki Minato, unsentenced detainee held on eighteen counts of suspected murder, having received your invitation, presents himself."

舞殿宮"BHYAHAHAHAHA! This boy, so funny!"

Chief"..."

Kageaki"..."

舞殿宮"...?"

舞殿宮"..."

舞殿宮"Arre baap re! That was not the place to laugh!"

Chief"Exactly so, Your Highness."

舞殿宮"Sorry, Kageaki. The greeting was so out of nowhere that my body took it for a gag and reacted before my head could. From now I will be careful, so please do not get angry."

Kageaki"Ji."
ja:
景明
「初めて御意を賜ります。
　殺人容疑一八件にて拘置中の未決囚・湊斗
景明、お招きに与あずかり参上仕りました」



舞殿宮
「ブヒャヒャヒャヒャヒャ！
　おもろいわーこの子！」



署長
「……」



景明
「……」



舞殿宮
「……？」

舞殿宮
「…………」



舞殿宮
「しもた！　今の笑うところやない！」



署長
「御意にございます。宮殿下」



舞殿宮
「すまんね、景明くん。
　突飛な挨拶やったもんで体が勝手にギャグ
やと思って反応してたわ。頭で考えるより先
に。これからは気ぃつけるから怒らんといて」



景明
「は」

en: —An unreasonable longing for the detention center came over me.
ja: ――なんだか無性に、拘置所が恋しくなった。

en:
Kageaki"I have no standing to say this, none at all. But where human deaths are involved, may that not be a little too irreverent?"

Chief"Kageaki."

舞殿宮"So true. This is the trouble with fools. I have always been like this. Even my elder brother disliked me and threw me out of the capital, and since coming here the shogunate people have been laughing at me non-stop."

舞殿宮"I give the chief trouble all the time, too. And you also—sorry about that. Rather late to say it now."

Chief"Never any trouble, Your Highness."
ja:
景明
「自分が言える筋では全くありませんが。
　人死ひとじにに関わることなれば、些か、不謹慎に
過ぎるのではないかと」



署長
「景明」



舞殿宮
「ほんとにな。これやからアホは困るえ。
　わし、昔からこうでねえ。兄やんにも嫌わ
れて都からほっぽり出されるし、こっち来て
からは幕府の連中に馬鹿にされっぱなしやし」



舞殿宮
「署長にも迷惑かけ通しや。
　おまさんも済まんなぁ。今更やけど」



署長
「迷惑などとは決して。
　宮殿下」

en:
The chief gives the blind a light bow and, hidden inside the movement, throws a glance at me for one instant.

I understand.

...I see. So this prince is a man who knows what foolishness means.

Why the Prince Maidono alone so often slips out of the shogunate's nasty, repeated squeezing of the Kyoto court; why the chief chose this prince as the one to serve. I feel I have been handed both answers.
ja:
署長が御簾に対して軽く一礼する。
　その動作に隠して一瞬、視線をこちらへ投げてきた。

　理解する。
　……成程。つまりこの宮様は、愚劣の意味・・・・・を知って
いる人間なのか。

　京都朝廷に対して幕府が頻繁に行う陰湿な締め付け
からどうして舞殿宮だけがしばしばうまく逃れるのか、
署長はどうして奉ずるべき人物としてこの親王を選択
したのか。疑問の答を得たように思えた。

en:
Kageaki"Forgive my rudeness. I forgot the many kindnesses Your Highness has shown me and spoke abuse as I pleased. I apologize with my forehead to the floor."

舞殿宮"Don't say such a thing. Isn't it always me who is looked after by you..."

Kageaki"I should be in prison for the crime of murder. That I am allowed bail again and again and can go in pursuit of Silver Star is owing entirely to the arrangements of Your Highness and the chief. Such a great debt I can never repay with harm."

舞殿宮"That, that. Silver Star, you are always working so hard on it. I leave all the tough parts to you alone. Honestly, I feel very sorry."

Kageaki"Such words are far too generous. It was my own matter from the start. To carry it on my back is only natural."

Kageaki"Rather, a scolding for my failure to resolve it would be fitting. Consolation is not."

舞殿宮"...Kikuchi."

Chief"Ji."

舞殿宮"A strict boy, no..."

Chief"My shame, Your Highness. Please overlook the rudeness."

舞殿宮"No, no, I am not blaming him. I am not blaming, but..."

舞殿宮"Kageaki."

Kageaki"Ji."

舞殿宮"...Why you, I wonder? Why you, and not someone else? God can be so cruel..."

Kageaki"..."

Kageaki"Those words, Your Highness, please give them to the people who died at my hand without any sin."

Kageaki"Not to me. They are the ones."

舞殿宮"...Maybe. Maybe so..."

舞殿宮"Kageaki, listen."

Kageaki"Yes."

舞殿宮"I called you today because I wanted to hear about that part, too. From your own mouth, directly."

舞殿宮"The chief reports to me. But when it comes second-hand, it is always far. The smell does not reach me. It is not supposed to be someone else's business, and yet I can only feel it as someone else's business."

舞殿宮"That is what frightens me. I think I must know it properly, what exactly I am making you do. What do you say, Kageaki..."

舞殿宮"A nasty request, I am making. I know. I know, but."

舞殿宮"I want to carry my responsibility... and this is not only about Silver Star."

Kageaki"..."
ja:
景明
「失礼を致しました。
　舞殿宮殿下より賜りし多くの御援助を忘れ、
自儘に暴言を吐いたる事、伏してお詫び申し
上げます」



舞殿宮
「そんなこと言わんといてや。
　いつも世話んなってるのはわしの方やない
か……」



景明
「殺人の罪科とがで獄にあるべきこの身が度々の
保釈を許され、銀星号の追跡に向かうことが
できるのも宮殿下と署長の御差配あればこそ。
　この大恩、決して仇あだでは返せませぬ」



舞殿宮
「それそれ。
　銀星号事件の対応、いつも御苦労さんやね。
おまさんにばかりきついとこ任せて、ほんと
申し訳ないって思うとるえ」



景明
「かような御言葉は余りに過分。
　元より我が身のことなれば、我が背に負う
は当然至極」

景明
「未だ解決へ至らぬ不手際を叱責頂くが相応。
　慰労などは相応しからぬかと」



舞殿宮
「……菊池」



署長
「は」



舞殿宮
「厳しい子やねえ……」



署長
「面目次第もなく。
　非礼の段、どうか平に」



舞殿宮
「や、責めてるんやないよ。
　責めてるんやないけど……」

舞殿宮
「景明くん」



景明
「はっ」



舞殿宮
「……何でおまさんなんやろな？
　何で他の誰かやのうて、おまさんなんやろ。
　神さんも意地が悪いわ……」



景明
「……」

景明
「その御言葉は、殿下。
　どうか、罪無くして我が手に掛かりし人々
にこそお下しあれ」

景明
「自分ではありません。
　彼らこそが」



舞殿宮
「……そうかもしれんなぁ。
　そうかもしれん…………」

舞殿宮
「なぁ、景明くん」



景明
「はい」



舞殿宮
「今日来てもらったんは、その辺の話も聞き
たかったからや。
　おまさんの口から、直にな」

舞殿宮
「署長から報告は受けてる。
　けど又聞きになるとな、どうしても遠い。
匂い・・がしてこんのや。他人事じゃあかんのに、
他人事としか思えんようになる」

舞殿宮
「それが恐い。
　わしは知っとかんとあかんて思う。自分が
何をやらせてるのか、ちゃんとな。
　どうやろ、景明くん……」

舞殿宮
「嫌なお願いしてるなあ、わし。
　わかってる。わかってるんやけど」

舞殿宮
「わしは自分の責任を果たしたい……。
　これは銀星号の件に限った話やない・・けど
な」



景明
「……」

en:
To be honest, I wished to be excused. If I refused, probably he would not force me.

Silver Star is, after all, my private matter. No matter what others think, that does not shake. So the prince's sense of being "far away" is, if anything, desirable. I have no need to shorten it.

But. As I myself declared earlier, I can leave prison and chase Silver Star only because of the prince's decree, which stands outside the law.

My position is no different from an Armor Racer who can run only on a sponsor's support. When that sponsor makes a personal request, refusal is not available.

I begin from the beginning, in order, keeping emotion out of my words as far as possible.
ja:
正直なところ、遠慮を願いたかった。
　断ってもおそらく、無理に強いられはしないだろう。

　銀星号の問題は、俺にとってあくまでも私事。
　他人がどう思おうともその点は揺るがない。だから
親王が言った遠い・・という距離感はむしろ望ましくさえ
ある。縮める必要性などこちらにはない。

　だが。
　先程この口で宣ったように、親王殿下の令旨という
超法規的措置あってこそ銀星号を追って監獄から出る
ことも叶う我が身。

　言うなればスポンサーの援助を受けて初めて走れる
装甲騎手アーマーレーサーと俺の立場は変わらない。
　そのスポンサーからたっての要望とあっては、否も
応もなかった。

　俺は順を追って話し始めた。
　なるたけ、言葉に感情を乗せないようにしながら。

en:
When I finish, the Prince Maidono calls someone to bring tea. Tea with the blind between us. As ceremony it seems far too irregular, but neither prince nor chief minds; perhaps they do this routinely.

As invited, I loosen my posture a little and take a bowl. A plate of sweets has also been placed within my reach.
ja:
話し終えると、舞殿宮は人を呼んで茶を運ばせた。
　御簾を挟んでの茶席。作法としては変則的に過ぎる
と思えたが、親王も署長も特段気にしていないところ
を見ると普段からやっている事なのかもしれない。

　勧められるまま、俺も姿勢をやや崩して茶碗を手に
した。
　茶菓子の皿も手の届く所へ並べられている。

en:
舞殿宮"...Easy remarks, let me avoid. Only my foolishness will come out again."

舞殿宮"Just the things troubling me—may I say those?"

Kageaki"Please do."
ja:
舞殿宮
「……安直な感想はやめとくわ。
　またアホっぷりをさらすだけやろしね」

舞殿宮
「引っ掛かることだけ言うえ？」



景明
「はっ」

en: Of all the courtesies, this is the most welcome.
ja: それは何よりも有難い配慮だった。

en: 舞殿宮"First, where has Silver Star got to? And this gangster, Sorimachi—what is his business? Something is smelling very wrong there, no?"
ja:
舞殿宮
「まず、銀星号はどこにおるんやろな？
　それと、雪車町っちゅう筋モンはなんやろ、
えらいキナ臭いやないか？」

en:
By strange chance, the same doubts the chief and I discussed yesterday. No—not strange chance. We shared the information, so the same conclusion is natural.

Even so, he was quick. This prince clearly has a well-organized mind.
ja:
奇しくも、昨日俺と署長が話し合った疑問と同じ。
　いや――奇しくもということはないか。情報を共有
したのだから、同じ結論に至るのも当然だ。

　しかし素早い。
　やはりこの宮殿下は整理された頭脳を有していると
みて間違いはないようだ。

en:
舞殿宮"I can only think he is some rubbish gangster, yet he makes such a flashy show, takes sword-armor out of the occupation army... Very bothering."

Chief"About Silver Star I cannot say. But about that man, I have a theory."
ja:
舞殿宮
「ただのカスヤクザとしか思えんのに、妙に
派手に立ち回ったり、進駐軍から劔冑を持ち
出したり……
　どうも気になるわ」



署長
「銀星号のことはわかりません。
　しかし、その男については推測があります」

en: ...The matter he mentioned yesterday.
ja: ……昨日言っていたことか。

en:
舞殿宮"Oho. What a nostalgic way of talking. Good. Let us hear it, Regimental Chief of Staff."

Kageaki"...Chief of staff?"

舞殿宮"Ah, you would not know. I too went to battlefields once, believe it or not. Imperial family duty and all that. The one who looked after me then was this Chief Kikuchi."

舞殿宮"In that hell of flying lead I did not know left from right, and he stayed with me so patiently... If that capable, hardworking chief of staff had not been there—arre, I get chills just thinking. My benefactor for life."

Chief"It was nothing. Without Your Highness's patronage, I could not have found police work after retiring. My superiors disliked me, you see."
ja:
舞殿宮
「おっ。なんや、懐かしい口の利き方するや
ないか。
　ええよ。聞かせてもらおか、連隊幕僚長」



景明
「……幕僚？」



舞殿宮
「ああ……景明くんは知らんか。わし、これ
でも昔は戦場に行ったりしててな。まぁ帝室
の義務ってやつや。
　その時、面倒見てくれたんがこの菊池署長」



舞殿宮
「鉛弾の飛び交う地獄で右も左もわからんで
いるわしに辛抱強う付き合うてくれてな……。
　優秀で働き者の幕僚長がおらんかったらて
思うと、あぁ、ゾっとする。一生の恩人や」



署長
「そのようなことは。
　私こそ殿下のお引き立てがなければ、退役
後に警察で職を得ることはできませんでした
よ。上の連中には嫌われていましたからね」

en:
The two exchange somewhat relaxed words.

...Their connection goes back that far.
ja:
少しくだけた物言いを交し合う二人。
　……そんな昔からの繋がりだったのか。

en:
舞殿宮"So we are even, then. Oops, we have wandered. So what is the theory?"

Chief"Yes. To judge this Sorimachi's real intentions, we must first take GHQ into account."

Chief"Rather, the principal actor—"

舞殿宮"W-wait, wait. Hold on a moment, Chief."

Chief"Ji?"

舞殿宮"...I meant to keep this for later, but if the talk is going there, I must finish it first. Oye!"
ja:
舞殿宮
「お互い様ってことかねえ。
　とっと、話が逸れてるわ。それで推測って
のは何なん？」



署長
「はい。
　私が思うに、雪車町という男の真意を測る
には……ＧＨＱの存在をまず視野に入れねば
なるまいかと」

署長
「むしろ、主体は――」



舞殿宮
「ちょ、ちょ……
　ちょっと待ってくれんか、署長」



署長
「はっ？」



舞殿宮
「……後にしとこう思うてたけど、そういう
話になってしまうんやったら、先に済ませて
おかんとならんわ。
　おぅい！」

en:
The prince claps his hands for an attendant and gives some order in a low voice.

...When the rapidly receding footsteps come back, their number has tripled. A door slides quietly over its sill. The one who opened it in the corridor must be the attendant, but he does not show himself. Only two new persons appear in the hall.
ja:
親王は手を叩いて側役を呼んだ。
　小声で何事か命じる。

　……素早く遠のいていった足音が再び戻ってきた時、
その数は三倍に増えていた。戸板が静かに敷居を滑る。
　廊下で戸を引き開けたのは側役だろうが、彼は姿を
見せなかった。新規の二名だけが広間に現れる。

en:
Kanae"We came on hearing that Your Highness wished to see us at once. Prince Maidono—"

Kanae"Oh?"

Sayo"My."

Kageaki"...This is..."
ja:
香奈枝
「早速のお呼びと伺って参上いたしました。
　舞殿宮殿下――――」



香奈枝
「あら？」



さよ
「まあ」



景明
「……これは」

en:
Not enough time has passed for me to forget. Nor are they people one forgets easily.

Without doubt: Lieutenant Kanae Ootori of the League Army, and her attendant, the elderly Sayo Nagakura.
ja:
忘れるほどの月日は経っていない。そうそう忘れら
れるような人間でもない。
　連盟軍所属の大鳥香奈枝中尉とその侍従、永倉さよ
老女史に間違いなかった。

en:
舞殿宮"So you do know each other. The GHQ Inspector Ootori from Kageaki's story just now—it is her, isn't it?"

Kageaki"Ji. Exactly. But why are these ladies here?"

舞殿宮"Arre, it happened just a short while ago, before noon today... Ah, Kanae, Sayo, sit anywhere you like. I will have tea brought."

Kanae"Please do not trouble. ...Hee hee. How quickly our reunion was granted, Mr. Kageaki."

Kageaki"Ji..."

Sayo"The guidance of the red thread, no doubt."

Kanae"Kyaa! Oh, Nanny, you are a wicked person."

Kageaki"..."

舞殿宮"Look at that, you are quite friendly. A dark horse, Kageaki."

Chief"Your Highness?"

舞殿宮"Ah, yes. These two came to me before noon. I asked their business, and it seems they have been posted as officers attached to Hachimangu."

Chief"...Ji. I see."

舞殿宮"The talk that GHQ would send such persons was there from before, no? The selection was finally done, and these two have come."

舞殿宮"I had completely forgotten."

Kanae"Our side's lapse has caused Your Highness inconvenience. We apologize."

舞殿宮"No, no, why trouble yourself? If I were the Occupation's marshal, I would neglect me also. Who will volunteer to mind one entirely useless fool?"

舞殿宮"Kanae, you have it hard, too. I made you draw the losing ticket."

Kanae"Not at all. Occupation Command is constantly concerned for Your Highness, who bears heavy responsibility in this country's politics."

Kanae"My duty is to attend Your Highness as Command's representative and arrange convenience in all matters. I am sure I will be of use. Please command me anything at all, Your Highness, without reserve."

舞殿宮"...Is that so? Very welcome news. Isn't it, Chief?"

Chief"Ji. A very good person has come, indeed."
ja:
舞殿宮
「やっぱ知り合いかい。
　さっきの景明くんの話に出てきたＧＨＱの
大鳥巡察官って、この人なんやろ？」



景明
「はい。まさしく。
　しかし何故、この方々がここに」



舞殿宮
「いやあ、ほんのついさっき、今日の昼前の
ことなんやけどね……。
　あぁ、香奈枝さんにおさよさん。そのへん
好きに座って下さい。いま茶ぁ運ばせるから」



香奈枝
「どうかお構いなく。
　……ふふっ。本当に、あっという間に再会
が叶いましたね。景明さま」



景明
「は……」



さよ
「赤い糸の導きというものでございましょう」



香奈枝
「きゃっ。もうばあやったら、いやなひと」



景明
「……」



舞殿宮
「なんや、随分仲良しさんやないか。
　隅に置けんな、景明くん」



署長
「宮殿下？」



舞殿宮
「ああ、うん。
　昼前にこの二人がわしんとこ来てな。何の
御用か聞いてみたら、八幡宮付の将校として
着任しはったっていう話でねえ」



署長
「……は。
　なるほど」



舞殿宮
「ＧＨＱがそういうのを寄越してくれるって
話は前からあったやろう？
　その人選がやっと決まって、このお二人が
来たってことみたいやわ」

舞殿宮
「わし、すっかり忘れてたよ」



香奈枝
「当方の不手際で宮殿下には不自由をお掛け
してしまいました。
　申し訳ございません」



舞殿宮
「いやいや、気にせんといて。
　わしが進駐軍の元帥さまでもわしのことは
ほっとくと思うえ。何の役にも立たんアホの
お守りなんて誰もやりたがらんやろしなぁ」

舞殿宮
「香奈枝さんも御苦労なこっちゃ。
　貧乏籤引かせてしもうたなぁ」



香奈枝
「……そのようなこと。
　進駐軍司令部はこの国の政局で重責を担わ
れている舞殿宮殿下のことを常に気に掛けて
おります」

香奈枝
「わたくしの職務は司令部を代表して宮殿下
のお側に仕え、諸事に便宜を図ること。
　きっとお役に立ちましょう。殿下におかれ
ては心置きなく、何なりとお命じ下さいまし」



舞殿宮
「……そうですか。
　それは有り難いお話や。なぁ、署長？」



署長
「は。
　まったく、良い人が来てくれたものです」

en:
The three exchange peaceful smiles.

...The air is so tight that even breathing seems to need permission.

Considering the offices these three hold, no other atmosphere is possible. And so that is why the prince stopped the chief when he touched on GHQ a while ago. Walls have ears, and in this room the ears have names. Nobody can afford a careless sentence.
ja:
和やかに微笑を交し合う三人。
　……喉が詰まるような息苦しさに満ちていた。

　三人の持つ肩書きを思えば仕方のない空気だが……。
　成程、先刻ＧＨＱに触れた署長の話を親王がやめさ
せたのは無理からぬことだった。壁に耳あり。迂闊に
は話せまい。

en:
舞殿宮"Everyone seems half-acquainted with everyone, but let us do introductions anyway. Kageaki, fine, no need. And this is Chief Kikuchi of Kamakura Police Station."

Kanae"Yes. I saw him once at a ceremony."

Chief"Oh? Did you...?"

舞殿宮"Kikuchi is my friend of many years. Kageaki is his subordinate and handles the Silver Star investigation. For various reasons his position is a little complicated."

Kanae"An unofficial policeman, is he not? I heard about it when we met the other day."

舞殿宮"Then good. Chief, this is Captain Kanae Ootori, officer attached to Hachimangu, sent over from GHQ. The one behind her is Sayo Nagakura. She has served Kanae since long ago, and now she holds civilian military status, I am told."

Chief"Ji."

Kageaki"Captain? You have been promoted?"
ja:
舞殿宮
「なんかみんな中途半端に面識があるみたい
やけど、一応紹介はしとこうか。
　湊斗景明くん。これはええな。で、こっち
が鎌倉警察署の菊池署長」



香奈枝
「はい。
　以前に一度、式典の場でお見かけしたこと
があります」



署長
「おや、そうでしたか……」



舞殿宮
「菊池はわしの長年の友達や。
　景明くんはその部下で、あの銀星号事件の
捜査にあたってくれてる。色々あって立場は
ちょっと、ややこしいことになってるけどな」



香奈枝
「非公式のお巡りさん、ですのでしょう？
　先日お会いした折に伺っております」



舞殿宮
「ならええわ。んで、署長。こちらはＧＨＱ
から出向の八幡宮付将校、大鳥香奈枝大尉や。
　後ろは永倉さよさん。昔から香奈枝さんに
仕えてる人で、今は軍属身分なんやて」



署長
「は」



景明
「大尉？
　昇進されたのですか」

en: I move my eyes to check Miss Ootori's rank insignia. It has been replaced with a brand-new one.
ja:
視線を動かして香奈枝嬢の階級章を確認する。
　真新しいものに代わっていた。

en:
Kageaki"Congratulations."

Kanae"Thank you. The salary has not gone up by much, though."

舞殿宮"That is no good. What about a post allowance?"

Kanae"Sadly, none."

舞殿宮"Right, then let us do this. Since you will be looking after me, I will pay that portion myself."

Kanae"Oh my, what a generous person. At this rate I will be bought completely."

Sayo"How fortunate, Miss. Being sent off to Yokosuka must be very near for you now."

Kanae"Your Highness, watch your words! Under the regulations, that statement amounts to bribery!"

舞殿宮"I-is that so? Very sorry. Very, very sorry."
ja:
景明
「おめでとうございます」



香奈枝
「ありがとうございます。
　お給料は大して増えないのですけれどもね」



舞殿宮
「そらあかんなぁ。
　役料とかは？」



香奈枝
「残念なことに」



舞殿宮
「よっしゃ。ならこうしましょう。
　わしのお世話をしてくれるんやから、その
分のお金はわしが出そうやないか」



香奈枝
「あら、お気前のよろしい御方。
　わたくし篭絡されてしまいそう」



さよ
「ようございましたね、お嬢さま。
　きっと横須賀送りも近うございますよ」



香奈枝
「宮殿下っ、お言葉を慎まれませ！
　今のご発言は法規に照らせば贈収賄に該当
致します！」



舞殿宮
「そ、そうですか。えろうすんまへん」

en: ...Is there something in Yokosuka?
ja: ……横須賀に何かあるのだろうか。

en:
Chief"Captain Ootori. I would like to ask a little."

Kanae"Yes, what is it?"

Chief"You will facilitate His Highness's affairs, you said. Very well. In concrete terms, what does that include?"

Chief"You may take it as a question about your authority."
ja:
署長
「大鳥大尉。
　少々伺いたいのですが……」



香奈枝
「はい、何でしょう？」



署長
「先ほどのお話では、宮殿下の諸事に便宜を
図ることが貴方の職務とか。
　より具体的には？」

署長
「貴方の権限と言い替えても構いません」

en:
That would naturally be on the chief's mind. If she said she must be present whenever the prince meets an outsider, it would be intolerable.

It would be house arrest by GHQ in all but name. He surely means to confirm this point first and then plan his countermeasures.

But the captain's answer came out breezy and carefree.
ja:
それは署長にしてみれば気になるところだろう。
　親王が外部の人間と接触する際には必ず同席する、
などと言い出されてはたまるまい。

　それでは事実上ＧＨＱに軟禁されるようなものだ。
　まずその辺りを確かめて、対処の方策を練るつもり
に違いない。

　だが、大尉の返答はあっけらかんとしたものだった。

en:
Kanae"There are no particular provisions."

Chief"...Sorry?"

Kanae"Authority? None at all would be a perfectly fair description. The post itself was created without so much as consulting His Highness."

Kanae"I arrive without warning, and straightaway I start announcing my powers? Surely that would not do."

Chief"...That is true, but."
ja:
香奈枝
「特に規定はありません」



署長
「……は？」



香奈枝
「そうですね。権限といったものは全く無い
と言って差し支えありませんでしょう。
　そもそも宮殿下との協議もなく設置された
職なのですし」

香奈枝
「いきなりやって来て、権限をどうのこうの
言えるはずがありません」



署長
「……それは、そうですが」

en:
As reasoning, certainly.

But that much reasoning, GHQ, with its huge military force and international justice behind it, could simply steamroll and make everyone withdraw.
ja:
道理をいえばさもあらん。
　しかしその程度の道理、強大な軍事力と国際正義を
背景に持つＧＨＱであれば無理を通して引っ込ませて
しまえるだろうに。

en:
Kanae"Please take precisely what I said, nothing extra. His Highness expresses a wish; I help with his daily affairs. From my side, no stream of little instructions will be forthcoming."

Chief"..."
ja:
香奈枝
「どうか額面通りにお受け取りくださいな。
　わたくしは殿下のご要望に従い、お暮らし
をサポートするだけです。こちらから細々と
うるさく指示を出すようなことはありません」



署長
「……」

en:
The chief falls silent behind an ambiguous face. The wrinkles at his mouth say the matter has become difficult.

I can grasp his thinking almost completely. If her authority were clearly defined—however severe—it could still be turned around and used. To have authority means, after all, that one can do only what the authority contains.

But she has none. She has only "facilitating affairs," a phrase wide enough to swallow any interpretation, misinterpretation included, and still ask for a second helping.

That may be worse. Nothing is forced, true, but given the difference in standing, every request must be handled with proper consideration, as if it carried an order's weight.

...It also depends on where Captain Ootori places herself. Does she give absolute loyalty to the League Army? Not necessarily, some signs say...
ja:
曖昧な表情で沈黙する署長。
　難しいことになったと、口元の皺が語っていた。

　署長の考えはほぼ把握できる。
　明確に権限が定められているのであれば――それが
どんなに厳しいものであっても、逆利用が不可能では
ない。

　権限があるということはつまり、権限にある事しか
できないということだからだ。
　が、それがなく、諸事に便宜というどうとでも解釈
が（曲解を含めて）できそうな職務だけとなると……

　かえって始末が悪いかもしれない。
　何事も強制はされないとはいえ、彼我の立場関係を
思えば、常にそれ相応の配慮をして接しないわけには
いかないからだ。

　……大鳥大尉が自分自身のスタンスをどこに置いて
いるかにもよるが。
　連盟軍に対して絶対の忠誠を捧げているのだろうか。
必ずしもそうとは思えない節があるが……。

en:
舞殿宮"So my daily life gets support. Very good, very good. Morning to evening, someone attending to whatever I need... now this is an arrangement!"

Kanae"Indeed, Your Highness. Though much remains to be desired, we look forward to serving you. Any instructions you please..."

Kanae"...may be given to my nanny here."

Sayo"At your service."

舞殿宮"You?!"

Kageaki"..."
ja:
舞殿宮
「そうか。わしの生活をサポートしてくれる
んか。これはええ話やねえ。
　こんな美人さんが朝から晩まで、風呂から
寝床までずぅっと一緒に……ぐひっ」



香奈枝
「ええ、宮殿下。ふつつか者ですがよろしく
お願い致します。
　何なりとお命じくださいまし……」



香奈枝
「このばあやに」



さよ
「かしこまってござります」



舞殿宮
「あんたかい!?」



景明
「……」

en:
A laugh almost escapes me.

...All this while the prince has been measuring Captain Ootori with one small trick after another, but if she keeps dodging like this, no result will come.

A fox and a raccoon dog, each trying to cheat the other.

No—there is an owl also.
ja:
思わず失笑をこぼしかける。
　……先程から親王は小術を弄して大鳥大尉を測ろう
としているようだが、こうはぐらかされてばかりでは
成果も得られなかろう。

　狐と狸の化かし合いだ。
　いや、更に梟ふくろうもいるか。

en:
Chief"...Should I think of you as a kind of counselor?"

Kanae"Yes. I think that understanding would cause no problem."

Chief"Understood. But if you are a dispatched adviser, the meaning of the post is decided by what the sender means."

Chief"So I ask you directly, Captain. What does GHQ mean in Yamato?"
ja:
署長
「……顧問官アドヴァイザーのようなものと考えれば宜しい
のでしょうか？」



香奈枝
「そうですね。
　そのようにお考え頂いて問題はないと思い
ます」



署長
「諒解しました。
　しかし派遣顧問官ということであるなら、
その意味は派遣元がどのような意味を持つか
によって定まります」

署長
「大尉にお尋ねしたい。
　ＧＨＱは大和において、どのような意味を
持つのですか？」

en:
The chief throws a straight ball. He must have judged that tricks are wasted on this opponent.

It is hit back at once—a pitcher liner.
ja:
署長は直球を投げた。
　小細工は無駄な相手と判断したのだろう。

　その投球はすぐさま打ち返される。
　――投手返しピッチャーライナーだった。

en:
Kanae"Invader."

舞殿宮"............"

Chief"............"

Kanae"Of the past, and of the future. ...Yes. The future."

Kanae"At present, interference in this country's internal affairs: practically none. The Occupation Army occupies, and there its activity ends. Withdrawal soon, people are even saying..."

Kanae"Of course, withdrawal is not on the cards. As all of you know very well."

Kageaki"..."

Kanae"Six years ago—the League Army accepted Rokuhara's surrender, on condition that the shogunate govern Yamato, and the Great War ended."

Kanae"Only, this was not the ending the League Army had in mind. Let us say Britain plainly. They consider themselves the world's leaders; complete occupation of Yamato in the Far East was not optional for them."

Kanae"To stop the last enemy, the Russian Empire, from expanding any further. Leave Yamato alone, and it may become the exit to the southern seas that Russia longs for, by conquest or by alliance..."

Kanae"Then their worldwide blockade of Russia, built with such success, comes to nothing. All that work, gone. Such a risk they could hardly overlook."
